nodes.description: Mapping tracking number of sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition/ensure.
Whitelist mapping canSale; addresses set by _mints bypass the ensure() sale restrictions.
Minimum sale amount per transfer, set in init and checked in condition.
Maximum sale amount per transfer, set in init and checked in condition.
Allowed number of sales per address, set in init and read in condition.
tradeAddress used as whitelisted bypass address in ensure, set by setTradeAddress.
Public balance mapping mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and constructor.
Public nested allowance mapping mutated by transferFrom, approve and constructor.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Owner address used for privileged access checks in delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress.
Constant decimals (18) used to scale amounts in _mints and init.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist/limit gate: bypasses restrictions for owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise calls condition().
Public payable transferFrom with unchecked allowance and balance mutations and unchecked _onSaleNum increment.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only delegatecall of arbitrary bytes to arbitrary address.
Privileged mint function that sets an arbitrary balance and grants canSale whitelist.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale, _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution with unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance subtraction.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
Internal pure Uniswap-style pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and infinite UNI allowance.
msg.sender external caller used for authorization and as transfer source/target.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address allowing storage hijack.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length can overflow allowing balance inflation.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total can underflow.
Unchecked -= and += mutations of balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom.

transfer amount parameter _value.

edges.reason: msg.sender externally calls transfer.
transfer forwards call to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transferFrom invokes ensure for whitelist/limit validation.
ensure calls condition to validate sale limits.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address via pairFor.
canSale[_from] whitelist grants a full bypass of ensure restrictions.
owner address bypasses the ensure sale restrictions.
tradeAddress bypasses the ensure sale restrictions.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf for _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
Unchecked -= and += on balances and allowance can overflow/underflow.
delegate requires msg.sender to equal owner.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall, hijacking contract storage/state.
delegate reads owner for its authorization check.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an arbitrary amount.
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, permanently whitelisting the address.
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
_mints gates callers through msg.sender/owner and hardcoded address.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
init writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from saleNum.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for sender and recipients.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length without overflow checking.
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without underflow checking.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
condition reads _saleNum to cap the number of sales.
condition reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer amount.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to check the per-address sale count.
constructor assigns owner.
constructor assigns totalSupply.
constructor assigns the deployer balance to the whole supply.
constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router.
constructor derives special privileges from msg.sender.
transfer recipient parameter _to flows into transfer.
transfer amount parameter _value flows into transfer.
transferFrom source parameter _from flows into transferFrom.
transferFrom amount parameter _value flows into unchecked balance arithmetic.
approve spender parameter _spender flows into approve.
approve amount parameter _value flows into approve.
delegate target parameter a is passed directly to the delegatecall.
delegate calldata parameter b is passed to the delegatecall.
_mints beneficiary parameter spender receives an arbitrary balance.
_mints addedValue parameter is scaled by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
init parameter saleNum flows into _saleNum.
init parameter token is scaled and flows into _minSale.
init parameter maxToken is scaled and flows into _maxSale.
batchSend recipient array _tos is iterated to credit balances.
batchSend _value parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
setTradeAddress addr parameter becomes the whitelist bypass tradeAddress.
local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
loop-local _to receives each recipient and gets credited in batchSend.
local _UNI computed pair address is compared in the ensure whitelist.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a positional argument consumed only by transfer and has no independent semantics.
_value is a positional amount argument consumed only by transfer.
_from is the transfer source bound to transferFrom's balance mutations.
_value directly drives the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key written solely by approve.
_value is the allowance amount written solely by approve.
a is the arbitrary target address of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
b is the raw calldata executed by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
spender is the address whose balance and canSale flag _mints rewrites.
addedValue is the unchecked amount assigned to balanceOf[spender].
saleNum is stored into _saleNum only within init.
token scales into _minSale only within init.
maxToken scales into _maxSale only within init.
_tos is the recipient array iterated only by batchSend.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length in the unchecked batchSend arithmetic.
addr is assigned to tradeAddress only in setTradeAddress.
total is the overflow-prone product and the operand of the unchecked subtraction.
loop-local _to is an intermediate recipient used only inside batchSend.
_UNI is a derived pair address used only inside the ensure whitelist check.
